faq.ricerca: how much is the heat pump grant
faq.q: How much is the heat pump grant?
faq.a: Under the Boiler Upgrade Scheme you get £7,500 off an air source (air-to-water) or ground source heat pump, £2,500 off an air-to-air heat pump and £5,000 off a biomass boiler. Homes off the gas grid that are heated by oil or LPG can get £9,000 towards an air source or ground source heat pump until 31 March 2027. There is one grant per property, and the installer takes it off your quote.

faq.q: Who can get the £9,000 heat pump grant?
faq.a: Ofgem lists £9,000 off an air-to-water or ground source heat pump for eligible off-gas-grid properties, available from 21 July 2026 until 31 March 2027. GOV.UK describes it as an extra £1,500 on top of the £7,500 when your property is heated by oil or LPG and has no mains gas connection. DESNZ counted {n9000} applications for the £9,000 grant from July to the end of September 2026, {quota9000} of all applications in those months.

faq.ricerca: heat pump grant uk end date
faq.q: When does the Boiler Upgrade Scheme end?
faq.a: DESNZ says the government confirmed funding for the scheme up to 2029/30, with a budget of £400 million for 2026/27. Vouchers are issued first come, first served until the budget for the financial year runs out. The higher £9,000 rate for oil and LPG homes is available until 31 March 2027.

faq.ricerca: can i get a grant for a heat pump
faq.q: Can I get a grant for a heat pump?
faq.a: GOV.UK says you are eligible if you own the property in England or Wales (a home, a second home, a property you let or a business building) and the heat pump replaces fossil fuel or electric heating such as gas, oil, LPG or electric heaters. It must be installed by an MCS certified installer, who applies for you. Most new builds, social housing and properties that already had government funding for a heat pump are excluded. Your installer and Ofgem check each property before a voucher is issued.

faq.ricerca: is the boiler upgrade scheme available in scotland
faq.q: Is the Boiler Upgrade Scheme available in Scotland?
faq.a: No. The scheme is open in England and Wales only. GOV.UK points people in Scotland to the Scottish Government's own home energy schemes, and says the Boiler Replacement Scheme in Northern Ireland is now closed.

faq.ricerca: how many heat pumps installed in uk
faq.q: How many heat pumps has the grant paid for?
faq.a: From May 2022 to the end of {mese}, the scheme paid grants for {pagati_pompe} heat pumps in England and Wales ({pagati_totale} installations including biomass boilers). This counts only installations paid through the Boiler Upgrade Scheme, not every heat pump fitted in the UK.

faq.q: What are the Boiler Upgrade Scheme eligibility criteria?
faq.a: GOV.UK lists two conditions for you: you must own the property you are applying for (including a business, a second home or a property you rent out) and you must be replacing fossil fuel heating such as oil, gas, electric or LPG. The installer must be MCS certified and must commission the heat pump within 120 days of applying. You are still eligible if you have already had funding for insulation.

faq.ricerca: can landlords get heat pump grant
faq.q: Can landlords get the heat pump grant?
faq.a: Yes. GOV.UK says you can apply for a property you rent out to tenants. Social housing is excluded: Ofgem defines it as accommodation provided at lower than market value to people who could not otherwise afford it, including shared ownership.

faq.ricerca: can you get a heat pump grant on a new build
faq.q: Can you get a heat pump grant on a new build?
faq.a: Usually not: most new build properties are excluded, and so are new builds the developer is still building. If you move into a finished new build that has a fossil fuel boiler, GOV.UK says you may be able to get the grant. Self-builds are eligible if you or the original owner built them (or paid a builder to) and they have never been owned by a business or organisation.

faq.q: Do I need an EPC for the Boiler Upgrade Scheme?
faq.a: The rules on Energy Performance Certificates have been loosened twice. From 8 May 2024 you no longer needed to have no outstanding loft and cavity wall insulation recommendations, and the changes of 28 April 2026 include “relaxing the requirement for a valid EPC”, in the words of DESNZ. Ofgem still suggests reading the improvements listed on your EPC if you have one. Your installer confirms what your application needs.

faq.ricerca: boiler upgrade scheme air to air 2500
faq.q: Can I get £2,500 for an air-to-air heat pump?
faq.a: Yes, since 28 April 2026 the scheme gives £2,500 off an air-to-air heat pump, for residential properties only. By the end of {mese} DESNZ had counted {aahp_domande} applications for air-to-air heat pumps and no grants paid yet; it will add air-to-air figures once the first grants are paid.

faq.ricerca: boiler upgrade scheme how to apply
faq.q: How do I apply for the Boiler Upgrade Scheme?
faq.a: You do not apply yourself. You get quotes from MCS certified installers, agree one, and that installer applies to Ofgem for you. Ofgem then asks you to confirm, within 14 calendar days, that the installer acts for you. After approval the installer has three months to fit the system (six months for a ground source heat pump) and claims the grant at the end; the grant is taken off your quote.

faq.q: Is there VAT on heat pumps in the UK?
faq.a: Ofgem says that from 1 April 2022 to 31 March 2027 the installation of energy-saving materials, including heat pumps and biomass boilers, is charged VAT at the zero rate. Ask your installer to confirm how VAT applies to your property and to show it on the quote.

faq.ricerca: is the boiler upgrade scheme available in wales
faq.q: Is the Boiler Upgrade Scheme available in Wales?
faq.a: Yes. The scheme covers England and Wales with the same rules and grant amounts. By the end of {mese} it had paid grants for {pagati_galles} installations in Wales.
